outcome_semantics.original_problem_closed: The exact current public statement is completely proved or refuted.
outcome_semantics.new_bound_or_scoped_theorem: A rigorous contribution exists but does not close the public statement.
outcome_semantics.writing_package_ready: A downstream exposition package has passed its own checks; this never implies closure.

targets.title: Bounded prime-multiple representations
targets.resume_gate: Supply a proved inequality that controls nonsquarefree prime-power fibres or couples three or more squarefree ranks; extending the finite prime list is insufficient.
targets.closure_contract: Prove the exact r=2 finite squarefree-support rank-two extremal theorem, including equivalence to weighted triangle-free graphs and a complete-bipartite optimiser.
targets.closing_lemma: Every positive vertex-product-weighted triangle-free graph has a complete bipartite graph on the same vertices with at least as much edge weight.

domain_expert.next_action: Audit repeated-prime m and the termination invariant in weighted symmetrisation.

targets.title: Signed harmonic sums at the lcm lattice spacing
targets.resume_gate: Prove that every sufficiently large n has a prime p in (n/2,n] with L_n/p not congruent to plus or minus 1 modulo p, or provide a different symbolic obstruction; a larger finite cutoff is insufficient.
targets.closure_contract: Find and independently verify exact finite witnesses or unsatisfiable instances for sum delta_k L_n/k=1, then accept a general claim only with an explicit infinite lift or eventual obstruction.
targets.closing_lemma: A stable lift or modular elimination rule valid for an infinite tail of n.

domain_expert.next_action: Reject any finite SAT/UNSAT pattern that lacks a symbolic transition in n.

targets.title: Density of divisor-subset-sum representability
targets.resume_gate: Give a symbolic description of the minimal lcm generators on an infinite subsequence, or a proved compression below the generic lcm-closure explosion; raising the 2,000,000-term cap is insufficient.
targets.closure_contract: Compute exact d_t through minimal lcm generators and promote no asymptotic statement without a symbolic subsequence proof.
targets.closing_lemma: A rigorously proved separation between two infinite subsequences, or a uniform asymptotic estimate.

domain_expert.next_action: Treat all finite exponent plots as diagnostics, never as universal evidence.

targets.title: Adjacent block product divisibility
targets.resume_gate: One admitted target must hit its first kill gate with at least 25 minutes unspent, and the lcm iteration must have a monotone termination measure.
